definitions.ask: Commit and push the fix mid-turn so the Mac's own `bob plugins sync` pulls it before live verification?
definitions.why: The Mac's bare sync pulls origin first, so only a pushed fix survives the next sync

choices.label: The Mac pulls the fix via its normal sync; later syncs (incl. bob-cli-a2.15's) keep it
Copy built files over SSH; a Mac sync before finalization redeploys the crashing 1.60.0
